title: Why the American Approach Is Failing

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》

sentences.en: Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: So far, the United States is losing the battle against the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，美国正在输掉这场抗击冠状病毒的战斗。

sentences.en: Donald G.
sentences.zh: 小唐纳德·G·

sentences.en: McNeil Jr.
sentences.zh: 麦克尼尔

sentences.en: on what it would take to turn the corner.
sentences.zh: 谈谈扭转局面需要付出什么。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, March 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月24日，星期二。

sentences.en: Donald, it is about 4.20 on Monday.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德，现在大约是星期一的4点20分。

sentences.en: Where are we in this pandemic in the United States?
sentences.zh: 我们在美国的这场大流行中处於什么位置？

sentences.en: How would you characterize it at this moment?
sentences.zh: 此时此刻你将如何描述它？

sentences.en: I would say it's wildly out of control, but we have not recognized it yet.
sentences.zh: 我会说它已经彻底失控，但我们还没有意识到这一点。

sentences.en: Certainly wildly out of control in New York State.
sentences.zh: 纽约州的疫情绝对已经彻底失控。

sentences.en: The epicenter in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国的震中

sentences.en: is now clearly
sentences.zh: 现在显然是

sentences.en: New York with more than 12,000 cases, most of them here in New York City.
sentences.zh: 纽约，拥有超过12,000个病例，其中大多数都在纽约市。

sentences.en: In Washington.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿。

sentences.en: The state of Washington has the second highest number with almost 1,000 cases.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州的病例数排在第二位，接近1,000例。

sentences.en: And then there's California.
sentences.zh: 然后是加利福尼亚州。

sentences.en: We have the third highest number.
sentences.zh: 我们的病例数排在第三位。

sentences.en: In Northern California, in South Florida.
sentences.zh: 在北加州，在南佛罗里达。

sentences.en: We saw pictures of Disney World jammed, packed with people.
sentences.zh: 我们看到迪士尼乐园挤满人的照片。

sentences.en: Aerial photos of beaches in Florida jammed with people.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州海滩挤满人的航拍照片。

sentences.en: There are still so many Americans that don't understand they are spreading the virus.
sentences.zh: 仍有如此多的美国人没有意识到他们正在传播病毒。

sentences.en: We've just begun to do tests, really.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我们才刚刚开始做检测。

sentences.en: We've got 42,000 positive cases.
sentences.zh: 我们已经有了42,000个阳性病例。

sentences.en: We've got 513 deaths.
sentences.zh: 我们已经有了513起死亡病例。

sentences.en: You know, some people have said this is like a war.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些人说这就像一场战争。

sentences.en: And it's as if your army has been marching forward and the enemy has been shooting at you for two to three weeks now.
sentences.zh: 这就好比你的军队一直在向前推进，而敌人已经向你开枪两到三周了。

sentences.en: And nobody has yet looked down to see whether or not they're bleeding.
sentences.zh: 而还没有人低头看看自己是否在流血。

sentences.en: But very soon, we will see how many people have been hit.
sentences.zh: 但很快，我们就会看到有多少人中枪了。

sentences.en: Because, you know, you get sick within four, five, six, seven days of getting infected.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，你在感染后的第四、五、六、七天内就会生病。

sentences.en: But usually, you don't need hospitalization if you're going to need hospitalization until about
sentences.zh: 但通常情况下，如果需要住院的话，你大约在

sentences.en: 10 days to two weeks in.
sentences.zh: 第10天到两周左右才需要住院。

sentences.en: It's known as the second week crash.
sentences.zh: 这被称为第二周崩溃。

sentences.en: And some people crash even after they thought they were starting to get better.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至在他们以为自己开始好转之后还会崩溃。

sentences.en: So we're facing something like that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们面临着这样的局面。

sentences.en: A lot of people are sick.
sentences.zh: 很多人都生病了。

sentences.en: Huge numbers of people are about to fall seriously ill.
sentences.zh: 大量的人即将重病。

sentences.en: But it just hasn't happened yet.
sentences.zh: 但它只是还没有发生。

sentences.en: Well, I want to talk about what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想谈谈美国

sentences.en: government and states have done so far.
sentences.zh: 政府和各州到目前为止做了什么。

sentences.en: How would you describe what has been done to try to mitigate this?
sentences.zh: 你会如何描述为试图缓解这一情况而采取的措施？

sentences.en: It's a giant patchwork across the country.
sentences.zh: 这是全国范围内的一个巨大的拼凑方案。

sentences.en: This is a moment we need to make tough decisions.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我们需要做出艰难决定的时刻。

sentences.en: This is a moment where we need some straight talk and we need to tell people the truth.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我们需要直言不讳、需要对人们说实话的时刻。

sentences.en: I mean, you see California ordering people to stay inside their houses.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你看到加利福尼亚州命令人们待在家里。

sentences.en: So we're going to put out an executive order today.
sentences.zh: 所以我们今天将发布一项行政命令。

sentences.en: New York state on pause.
sentences.zh: 纽约州暂停营业。

sentences.en: New York requesting that people stay inside their houses and closing down all non-essential businesses.
sentences.zh: 纽约要求人们待在家里并关闭所有非必要企业。

sentences.en: A stay-at-home order for all of Ohio.
sentences.zh: 针对全俄亥俄州的居家令。

sentences.en: You have Ohio and Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 你有俄亥俄州和路易斯安那州。

sentences.en: Today, I'm issuing a stay-at-home order for the entire state of Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 今天，我为整个路易斯安那州发布居家令。

sentences.en: Moving in the same direction.
sentences.zh: 朝着相同的方向发展。

sentences.en: Which will become effective tomorrow, Monday, March 23rd at 5 p.m.
sentences.zh: 该命令将于明天（3月23日星期一）下午5点生效。

sentences.en: The federal government has recommended no gatherings of more than 10 people.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府建议不要举行超过10人的集会。

sentences.en: Some states are enforcing that even more harshly than that, like California.
sentences.zh: 一些州执行得比这更严厉，比如加利福尼亚州。

sentences.en: Other states are setting their own policies.
sentences.zh: 其他州则在制定自己的政策。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And as patchy and inconsistent as this approach may be, there's beginning to be real blowback to this government-mandated social distancing
sentences.zh: 尽管这种方法可能拼凑且不一致，但对于这种政府强制的社交距离

sentences.en: and shutting down our society, given that it is putting people out of work, it's closing businesses.
sentences.zh: 以及关闭我们的社会的做法，已经开始出现真正的强烈反对，因为它让人失业，让企业倒闭。

sentences.en: The president has said just in the past few hours...
sentences.zh: 就在过去几个小时里，总统表示……

sentences.en: We cannot let the cure be worse than the problem itself.
sentences.zh: 我们不能让治疗本身比问题本身更糟糕。

sentences.en: We're not going to let the cure be worse than the problem.
sentences.zh: 我们不会让治疗比问题更糟糕。

sentences.en: He doesn't want the cure to be worse than the illness itself.
sentences.zh: 他不想让治疗方案比疾病本身更糟糕。

sentences.en: So, I want to understand why we're pursuing this approach rather than a variety of alternatives.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想了解为什么我们采取这种方法，而不是各种替代方案。

sentences.en: And let's start with the South Korean approach, right?
sentences.zh: 让我们从韩国的方法开始，对吧？

sentences.en: Not closing all businesses.
sentences.zh: 不关闭所有企业。

sentences.en: Not closing all restaurants.
sentences.zh: 不关闭所有餐馆。

sentences.en: Focusing instead on aggressively tracking the sick and testing as many people as possible.
sentences.zh: 而是专注于积极追踪病患并尽可能多地检测人们。

sentences.en: And it seems to be working, right?
sentences.zh: 而且这似乎正在起作用，对吧？

sentences.en: So, why can't we do that here?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么我们这里不能这样做？

sentences.en: Why isn't that a viable alternative to shutting things down?
sentences.zh: 为什么这不是关闭各项事务的一个可行替代方案？

sentences.en: Well, we could do that here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们这里也可以这样做。

sentences.en: If we had a time machine and we could travel back in time to about January 20th, because January 15th is where we know one of the first cases arrived in the United States
sentences.zh: 如果我们有一台时间机器，能够回到大约1月20日，因为我们知道其中一个首批病例是在1月15日抵达美国的

sentences.en: and started spreading.
sentences.zh: 并开始传播的。

sentences.en: That was the case in Washington.
sentences.zh: 那是华盛顿的病例。

sentences.en: The idea that we could try to start cracking down now when we have over 40,000 cases and 500 deaths, it's just utterly impossible.
sentences.zh: 当我们拥有超过40,000个病例和500起死亡病例时，再去尝试进行打击的想法，简直完全不可能。

sentences.en: It's not close to anything that South Korea faced.
sentences.zh: 这与韩国所面对的情况完全不可同日而语。

sentences.en: I mean, South Korea, they were doing this kind of crackdown when they first saw cases arriving before there was a single death.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，韩国在他们第一次看到病例抵达、甚至还没有出现单一死亡病例时，就在进行这种打击了。

sentences.en: So, we're just behind the eight ball on that kind of thinking.
sentences.zh: 所以，在那种思维上我们已经远远落后了。

sentences.en: And mostly they had small scattered cases.
sentences.zh: 而且他们大多是分散的小型病例。

sentences.en: And then they had this gigantic explosion inside one church.
sentences.zh: 然后他们在一家教堂内部爆发了巨大的疫情。

sentences.en: I think it was more than 500 cases inside that church.
sentences.zh: 我想那座教堂内部有超过500个病例。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: They managed to do contact tracing on 210,000 members of that church.
sentences.zh: 他们设法对该教堂的21万名成员进行了接触者追踪。

sentences.en: Los Angeles just gave up contact tracing today.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶今天刚刚放弃了接触者追踪。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Just knowing that they don't have the test to do it.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是因为他们知道自己没有进行检测的能力。

sentences.en: Meaning tracing those who were in contact with somebody who has tested positive.
sentences.zh: 也就是追踪那些与检测呈阳性的人有过接触的人。

sentences.en: Tracing everybody who was in contract with somebody who was tested positive.
sentences.zh: 追踪每一个与检测呈阳性的人有过接触的人。

sentences.en: Not only everybody they've been in contact with since they knew they were infected, but everybody even 48 hours before that.
sentences.zh: 不仅是他们自知感染以来接触过的所有人，甚至包括在那之前48小时内接触过的所有人。

sentences.en: So, not only is it too late to follow the South Korean model, you're saying as an alternative in the U.S., we just don't have the capacity or the resources to follow it.
sentences.zh: 所以，不仅是效仿韩国模式为时已晚，你的意思是作为美国的替代方案，我们根本没有能力或资源去遵循它。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, we can dispense with that.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们可以省去那个方案了。

sentences.en: Another possible alternative to just shutting everything down is isolating the most vulnerable in American society to the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 除了彻底关闭一切，另一个可能的替代方案是隔离美国社会中对冠状病毒最脆弱的人群。

sentences.en: So, the elderly, those with pre-existing conditions, underlying medical problems, rather than asking everyone to isolate in some form or another.
sentences.zh: 因此，是老年人、有基础疾病和潜在医疗问题的人，而不是要求每个人以这样或那样的方式进行隔离。

sentences.en: And in that scenario, most Americans would be treated as we treat most Americans during the regular flu season, right?
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，大多数美国人将被当作我们在常规流感季节对待大多数美国人那样对待，对吧？

sentences.en: Take some precautions, be careful, but don't fundamentally alter your life.
sentences.zh: 采取一些预防措施，小心谨慎，但不要从根本上改变你的生活。

sentences.en: And there are doctors who seem to be advocating for this isolate the most vulnerable scenario.
sentences.zh: 有些医生似乎在主张这种隔离最脆弱人群的方案。

sentences.en: And one of our colleagues, columnist Tom Friedman, gave voice to their views over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我们的同事、专栏作家汤姆·弗里德曼在周末表达了他们的观点。

sentences.en: And it seems President Trump is interested in this kind of a concept.
sentences.zh: 而且特朗普总统似乎对这种概念很感兴趣。

sentences.en: What do the experts that you have talked to say about the viability of that?
sentences.zh: 你交谈过的专家对这种方案的可行性是怎么说的？

sentences.en: This was an idea that was floated for a while in the Netherlands and was floated for a while in the UK
sentences.zh: 这个想法曾在荷兰流传了一段时间，也曾在英国流传了一段时间

sentences.en: and dropped because they realized that it was ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 并被放弃了，因为他们意识到这很荒谬。

sentences.en: Why is it ridiculous?
sentences.zh: 为什么这很荒谬？

sentences.en: One, how do you only isolate the elderly?
sentences.zh: 第一，你如何只隔离老年人？

sentences.en: Elderly people in this country very often live with their families.
sentences.zh: 这个国家的老年人往往与他们的家人住在一起。

sentences.en: Elderly people need services which people deliver to them in their houses or they go to community centers or to their relatives' houses for services they absolutely need
sentences.zh: 老年人需要人们送到他们家里的服务，或者他们去社区中心或亲戚家寻求他们绝对需要的服务

sentences.en: from everything from food to company.
sentences.zh: 从食物到陪伴，无所不包。

sentences.en: How do you isolate the vulnerable?
sentences.zh: 你如何隔离脆弱人群？

sentences.en: How do you isolate everybody who's obese in this country?
sentences.zh: 你如何隔离这个国家里每一个肥胖的人？

sentences.en: Why do you mention obese?
sentences.zh: 你为什么提到肥胖？

sentences.en: Because many have diabetes.
sentences.zh: 因为许多人患有糖尿病。

sentences.en: And diabetes is one of the conditions that renders you more susceptible to dying of this disease.
sentences.zh: 而糖尿病是让你更容易死于这种疾病的病症之一。

sentences.en: Everybody who's got high blood pressure, not all high blood pressure, but uncontrolled high blood pressure, which a lot of people do in this country,
sentences.zh: 每一个患有高血压的人——并非所有高血压，而是不受控制的高血压（这个国家很多人都有）——

sentences.en: is more susceptible to this disease.
sentences.zh: 都更容易感染这种疾病。

sentences.en: Anybody who's taken any sort of immunosuppressive drugs or is fairly recently been on cancer treatment may be more susceptible to this disease.
sentences.zh: 任何服用过某种免疫抑制药物或最近接受过癌症治疗的人，可能更容易感染这种疾病。

sentences.en: There's some data suggesting now that people who vape may be more susceptible to developing pneumonia from this disease.
sentences.zh: 现在有一些数据表明，吸电子烟的人可能更容易因这种疾病而发展成肺炎。

sentences.en: Vaping is not something that's common among the elderly in this country.
sentences.zh: 吸电子烟在这个国家的老年人中间并不常见。

sentences.en: So you're saying there are just too many vulnerable populations for this to be practical?
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，脆弱人群实在太多，以至于这个方案不切实际？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So the idea that you can just isolate all the most vulnerable people in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可以隔离美国所有最脆弱人群的想法

sentences.en: is simply wishful thinking.
sentences.zh: 纯粹是一厢情愿。

sentences.en: So given that, Donald, I want to talk through another possible alternative, one that President Trump seems to be talking up a lot in the past couple of days.
sentences.zh: 鉴于此，唐纳德，我想讨论另一种可能的替代方案，这是特朗普总统在过去几天里似乎经常谈论的一个方案。

sentences.en: It's a common malaria drug.
sentences.zh: 这是一种常见的抗疟疾药物。

sentences.en: It's been available, so therefore the safety level we understand very well.
sentences.zh: 它一直可用，因此我们对它的安全性非常了解。

sentences.en: It's been relatively safe.
sentences.zh: 它相对安全。

sentences.en: Which is the idea that we are close to a treatment to the coronavirus, something that would reliably combat it and mean that we don't need to shut down societies.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们接近找到冠状病毒治疗方法的想法，某种能够可靠对抗它并意味着我们不需要关闭社会的药物。

sentences.en: We're also studying this and other promising therapies, which is a therapy produced by Gilead, and that would be reMs.
sentences.zh: 我们还在研究这种药物和其他有前景的疗法，这是一种由吉利德生产的疗法，那将是 rem

sentences.en: It's called remdesivir, remdesivir, and it shows great promise.
sentences.zh: 它被称为瑞德西韦，瑞德西韦，它展现出了巨大的前景。

sentences.en: So tell me about these drugs that President Trump has been referring to and whether he is right to suggest that they might be a solution here.
sentences.zh: 所以跟我说说特朗普总统一直提到的这些药物，以及他暗示它们可能是这里的解决方案是否正确。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The drugs that President Trump has mentioned over the past week are chloroquine and hydroxychloroquine, which are two versions of a longstanding malaria drug.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统过去一周提到的药物是氯喹和羟氯喹，这是一种长期抗疟疾药物的两个版本。

sentences.en: It goes back 70 years.
sentences.zh: 它可追溯到70年前。

sentences.en: And the other drug is called remdesivir.
sentences.zh: 另一种药物被称为瑞德西韦。

sentences.en: And it's a drug made by Gilead, and it doesn't actually have any use.
sentences.zh: 这是吉利德制造的一种药物，实际上它没有任何用途。

sentences.en: I think they may have hoped it would work against HIV, and it definitely did not work against Ebola when they tried it.
sentences.zh: 我想他们当时可能是希望这种药能对抗艾滋病，而当他们尝试用它对抗埃博拉时，确实毫无效果。

sentences.en: But now they're hoping it works against coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 但现在他们希望它能对抗冠状病毒。

sentences.en: There's some evidence to suggest it does.
sentences.zh: 有一些证据表明它确实有效。

sentences.en: I mean, there's evidence in animal testing to suggest that both of these drugs might possibly work.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，动物实验中的证据表明这两种药物可能都有效。

sentences.en: Those drugs have been used in China, but this was by doctors who were desperate, who were basically throwing everything they had at patients.
sentences.zh: 这些药物在中国被使用过，但那是由于医生们走投无路，基本上是把他们手头所有的东西都用在了患者身上。

sentences.en: And in some cases where doctors had a certain number of patients, they said, gee, these patients seemed to do better when I gave them that drug.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，当医生治疗了一定数量的患者后，他们会说，天哪，当我给这些患者使用这种药时，他们的情况似乎有所好转。

sentences.en: Now, that doesn't mean, you know, this was some sort of Lazarus-like rise from your hospital bed and walk away, smiling, miracle drug.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着，你知道的，这就像是某种能让你从病床上起死回生、微笑着走开的神奇药物。

sentences.en: This was a drug that seemed to let these patients have better outcomes.
sentences.zh: 这只是一种似乎能让这些患者获得更好治疗结果的药物。

sentences.en: But they weren't able to do, for several reasons, real clinical trials where you have two groups of patients who are basically exactly equal to each other,
sentences.zh: 但出于几个原因，他们无法进行真正的临床试验，即让两组患者在各方面完全相同，

sentences.en: and half of them get the drug and half don't.
sentences.zh: 其中一半人使用药物，另一半不用。

sentences.en: That's what you need in order to be sure that a drug really works.
sentences.zh: 为了确信一种药物是否真的有效，你需要这样做。

sentences.en: Once you license a drug, then doctors start giving it all over the place.
sentences.zh: 一旦某种药物获准上市，医生们就会开始到处开这种药。

sentences.en: Actually, chloroquine is already licensed, so doctors are giving it in the hopes that it will work.
sentences.zh: 事实上，氯喹已经获批上市，所以医生们正在使用它，希望能起作用。

sentences.en: And patients are demanding it in the belief that it will work, the belief partially spread by the president.
sentences.zh: 患者也在强烈要求使用它，坚信它会起作用，这种信念部分是由总统传播开来的。

sentences.en: And we don't really know how well it works.
sentences.zh: 而我们并不真正知道它到底有多大疗效。

sentences.en: And these drugs are not completely safe.
sentences.zh: 而且这些药物并非完全安全。

sentences.en: They shouldn't be taken, especially by children,
sentences.zh: 不应该服用，尤其是儿童，

sentences.en: without medical supervision.
sentences.zh: 除非有医疗监督。

sentences.en: And, you know, the fear is that false hopes will be raised and that also people get so excited about it that some may start taking the drugs to protect themselves out of fear
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，人们担心的是，这会燃起虚假的希望，而且人们会对此过于兴奋，以至于有些人出于恐惧，开始服用这些药物来保护自己，

sentences.en: if they've managed to get a hold of a bottle.
sentences.zh: 如果他们设法弄到了一瓶药的话。

sentences.en: And they may end up poisoning their kids.
sentences.zh: 他们最终可能会毒害自己的孩子。

sentences.en: You know, these are bad outcomes.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这些都是糟糕的结果。

sentences.en: There is a case where the cure is worse than the disease.
sentences.zh: 这种情况属于治愈方法比疾病本身还要糟糕。

sentences.en: So beyond the fact that there's not yet enough medical evidence that this is a legitimate set of treatments, there's potentially real medical risk in people starting to take them
sentences.zh: 因此，除了目前还没有足够的医学证据证明这是一套合法的治疗方案之外，人们开始服用这些药物还存在潜在的现实医疗风险，

sentences.en: because they might actually make people sick.
sentences.zh: 因为它们实际上可能会让人病情加重。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay, so with all those options basically deemed impractical, that would seem to bring us back to social isolation.
sentences.zh: 好的，既然所有这些选择基本都被认为是不切实际的，那么这似乎让我们回到了保持社交距离的老路上。

sentences.en: But is that working?
sentences.zh: 但这管用吗？

sentences.en: Because my sense is, so far in the United States, it is not working.
sentences.zh: 因为我的直觉是，到目前为止在美国，这并没有起作用。

sentences.en: No, it's not working.
sentences.zh: 不，没有起作用。

sentences.en: And that's because we're not doing it right.
sentences.zh: 那是因为我们没有做好。

sentences.en: And, you know, to write the articles I've been writing recently, I talked to a dozen top experts, you know, not just at the World Health Organization,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，为了写我最近一直在写的文章，我和十几位顶级专家进行了交流，你知道，不仅仅是世界卫生组织的人，

sentences.en: but people who run medical schools, people who have fought pandemics, people who fought Ebola, people fought SARS, people who fought MERS.
sentences.zh: 还有医学院的负责人、抗击过大流行病的人、抗击过埃博拉的人、抗击过SARS的人、抗击过MERS的人。

sentences.en: And they say that if we're going to get a grip on our epidemic, we have to imitate China because we've got China-like spread.
sentences.zh: 他们说，如果我们想要控制住这场疫情，就必须模仿中国，因为我们的病毒传播情况和中国很像。

sentences.en: We're not going to be able to catch it up with a South Korea-like program.
sentences.zh: 我们不可能通过类似韩国的方案来赶上进度。

sentences.en: And we're going to have to, you know, do a whole lot better than Italy and Iran did.
sentences.zh: 而且我们必须，你知道的，做得比意大利和伊朗好得多。

sentences.en: And we're not on that track right now.
sentences.zh: 我们目前还没有走上那条轨道。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 你现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请立即下载时报应用，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So if the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果美国

sentences.en: is failing at social isolation, what would the ideal version of social isolation look like right now?
sentences.zh: 在保持社交距离方面做得失败，那么现在理想版本的社交隔离会是什么样的？

sentences.en: What would it entail?
sentences.zh: 它会包含哪些内容？

sentences.en: So in an ideal world, if you could wave a magic wand and make everybody in the United States freeze in place, sitting six feet apart from each other for two weeks,
sentences.zh: 所以在理想的世界里，如果你能挥舞魔杖，让美国的所有人都静止在原地，彼此相隔六英尺坐两周，

sentences.en: we could stop the epidemic in two weeks.
sentences.zh: 我们就能在两周内遏制住疫情。

sentences.en: If we had enough tests.
sentences.zh: 如果我们有足够的检测手段的话。

sentences.en: Yeah, because within two weeks, the virus would die out on every surface that it was.
sentences.zh: 对，因为在两周内，病毒会在它存在的所有表面上消亡。

sentences.en: People wouldn't be interacting, so they wouldn't transmit it.
sentences.zh: 人们不会进行互动，所以就不会传播病毒。

sentences.en: And everybody who has symptoms, the symptoms turn up in two weeks at the moSt.
sentences.zh: 而且所有出现症状的人，症状最多在两周内就会显现出来。

sentences.en: So you'd know who was sick.
sentences.zh: 所以你会知道谁生病了。

sentences.en: And even for the few asymptomatics, you'd be able to find them by doing tests.
sentences.zh: 甚至对于少数无症状感染者，你也能通过检测把他们找出来。

sentences.en: And so that'd be it.
sentences.zh: 事情就会是这样。

sentences.en: Epidemic over.
sentences.zh: 疫情结束。

sentences.en: I mean, you'd have a lot of people in the hospitals, but that would be the end of it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，医院里会有很多人，但事情就会这样画上句号。

sentences.en: Knowing that we don't have a magic wand, but wish we did, what do we do?
sentences.zh: 既然我们没有魔杖，虽然我们希望有，那我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: What's the playbook for how to keep people away from each other in the United States, given where the virus is?
sentences.zh: 鉴于病毒目前的传播情况，在美国如何让人们保持距离的行动方案是什么？

sentences.en: As much as possible, we have to stop everything in places where we know the virus is.
sentences.zh: 在已知病毒存在的地区，我们必须尽可能叫停一切活动。

sentences.en: That is what China did.
sentences.zh: 这就是中国所做的事情。

sentences.en: They knew the virus was incredibly hot in Wuhan and the surrounding province.
sentences.zh: 他们知道病毒在武汉及周边省份极其猖獗。

sentences.en: And so they put that entire province on lockdown.
sentences.zh: 所以他们对整个省实施了封锁。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, that means not just stopping all air travel.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这意味着不仅要叫停所有航空旅行。

sentences.en: It means basically stopping all travel.
sentences.zh: 这意味着基本上要叫停所有的出行。

sentences.en: I mean, people can't be together on buses.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人们不能一起坐公交车。

sentences.en: People can't be together on planes.
sentences.zh: 人们不能一起坐飞机。

sentences.en: People can't be together in cars unless it's just them and they're going to socially isolate together when they get to the end of their journey
sentences.zh: 人们不能一起坐汽车，除非车里只有他们自己，而且当他们到达行程终点时，他们会一起进行社交隔离，

sentences.en: and stay in place for, unfortunately, an indefinite amount of time.
sentences.zh: 并在原地呆上不幸的是不确定的一段时间。

sentences.en: The loosey-goosier the freeze is, the longer it lasts and the longer it's going to take us to get our economy started again.
sentences.zh: 这种静止状态越松散，持续的时间就越长，我们重启经济所需的时间也就越长。

sentences.en: Because the looser it is, the more transmission there is.
sentences.zh: 因为越松散，传播就越多。

sentences.en: The more transmission there is, the more people end up overcrowding hospitals.
sentences.zh: 传播越多，最终拥挤到医院的人就越多。

sentences.en: The more people overcrowd hospitals, the more people die.
sentences.zh: 医院拥挤的人越多，死亡的人就越多。

sentences.en: Okay, so that's transportation.
sentences.zh: 好的，这就是交通运输方面。

sentences.en: And you're suggesting that, in many ways, we have to further restrict that.
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，在许多方面，我们必须进一步限制交通。

sentences.en: What about businesses?
sentences.zh: 那企业呢？

sentences.en: What about restaurants all over the country?
sentences.zh: 全国各地的餐馆怎么办？

sentences.en: Do they need to be shut down?
sentences.zh: 它们需要被关闭吗？

sentences.en: Yes, all of these things.
sentences.zh: 是的，所有这些都要关。

sentences.en: Transportation, restaurants all over the country, schools all over the country,
sentences.zh: 交通运输、全国各地的餐馆、全国各地的学校、

sentences.en: workplaces all over the country, bars and restaurants all over the country.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的工作场所、全国各地的酒吧和餐馆。

sentences.en: And different places are turning into hotspots even as we speak because people are now traveling all over the country and still spreading the virus, starting new clusters.
sentences.zh: 就在我们说话的时候，不同的地方正在变成热点地区，因为人们现在仍在全国各地旅行并传播病毒，引发新的聚集性疫情。

sentences.en: The only way to get on top of this disease is to stop the clusters.
sentences.zh: 控制住这种疾病的唯一方法就是遏制这些聚集性疫情。

sentences.en: In this scenario that you're describing, what can be open?
sentences.zh: 在你所描述的这种情况下，什么地方可以营业？

sentences.en: What's an acceptable reason for anyone to be out and about?
sentences.zh: 对任何人来说，外出活动的合理理由是什么？

sentences.en: Doctors, nurses, people who work in the healthcare field, police, fire, the people who keep the water mains open and the electrical grid running and Wi-Fi reaching houses,
sentences.zh: 医生、护士、医疗领域的工作人员、警察、消防员、维持输水管道畅通、电网运行以及Wi-Fi信号覆盖到家家户户的人，

sentences.en: and food delivery, and medicine delivery.
sentences.zh: 还有食品配送员和药品配送员。

sentences.en: That's the ideal is that those are the only people who are allowed out and that keep the country functioning.
sentences.zh: 理想状态是，只有这些人被允许外出，并维持国家的运转。

sentences.en: We need people to freeze in place and we need to make sure they have enough calories and water and medicine to stay alive.
sentences.zh: 我们需要人们原地静止，我们需要确保他们有足够的卡路里、水和药物来维持生命。

sentences.en: You know, not that they are worried about how their business is running and how their investments are going or whether or not they're collecting their rents.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，而不是让他们担心自己的生意怎么经营、投资情况如何，或者是否能收到房租。

sentences.en: And we have to do things like tell landlords that they can't collect their rents, tell banks that they can't collect their mortgages.
sentences.zh: 我们必须采取诸如告诉房东不能收房租、告诉银行不能收房贷之类的措施。

sentences.en: The idea is to keep the country alive until the virus slows down.
sentences.zh: 我们的想法是让国家维持生存，直到病毒传播速度放缓。

sentences.en: It may be impossible, but if you want to try to use any sort of social distancing tactic, it has to be much more intense than it is now because we're not slowing the virus.
sentences.zh: 这或许是不可能的，但如果你想尝试使用任何形式的保持社交距离的策略，它的力度必须比现在大得多，因为我们根本没有让病毒的速度慢下来。

sentences.en: It's still spreading wildly.
sentences.zh: 它仍在疯狂传播。

sentences.en: And this slowdown, how would it be enforced in a place like the United States?
sentences.zh: 这种速度放缓，在美国这样的大都市将如何得以强制执行？

sentences.en: Let's say that suddenly every state, every mayor locks down a community along the lines of what experts say needs to be done now to freeze this in place.
sentences.zh: 假设突然之间，每个州、每个市长都按照专家目前所说的那样封锁社区，以使一切在原地静止。

sentences.en: How does it actually get enforced?
sentences.zh: 这到底该如何强制执行？

sentences.en: Who is in charge of punishing those who violate it, roaming the streets and making sure it actually happens?
sentences.zh: 谁负责惩罚那些违反规定的人、在街上巡逻并确保这一切切实发生？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, legally, you can do it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，从法律上讲，你是可以做到的。

sentences.en: The governor and the health commissioner have the power to use the police to enforce these laws.
sentences.zh: 州长和卫生专员有权力动用警察来强制执行这些法律。

sentences.en: In Italy, as in China, they went to roadblocks everywhere.
sentences.zh: 在意大利，和中国一样，他们到处设置路障。

sentences.en: You couldn't drive down a street without a permit that had been issued by the government that said,
sentences.zh: 如果你没有政府签发的许可证，你就无法开车上街，许可证上会写着，

sentences.en: I'm an emergency worker.
sentences.zh: 我是一名应急人员。

sentences.en: I am allowed to drive down the street.
sentences.zh: 我被允许开车上街。

sentences.en: That's what will have to happen if people don't do it voluntarily.
sentences.zh: 如果人们不自愿配合，这就是将要发生的情况。

sentences.en: And I fully expect that Americans are not going to do this voluntarily, but then we're going to suffer the consequences.
sentences.zh: 而且我完全预计美国人不会自愿这样做，但随后我们将承受相应的后果。

sentences.en: So what happens if we don't do all the things that experts are saying we must do, the social isolation, the lockdowns?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们不做专家们所说我们必须做的事情，比如社交隔离、封锁，会发生什么？

sentences.en: It doesn't seem we're headed there.
sentences.zh: 我们似乎并没有朝那个方向发展。

sentences.en: So what happens if we don't implement any of these measures?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果我们不实施这些措施会发生什么？

sentences.en: If we don't implement these measures,
sentences.zh: 如果我们不实施这些措施，

sentences.en: we will have a Wuhan in New York and a Wuhan in Seattle and a Wuhan in South Florida and a Wuhan in Wheeling, West Virginia and a Wuhan in Helena, Montana and so on
sentences.zh: 纽约就会出现一个武汉，西雅图会出现一个武汉，南佛罗里达会出现一个武汉，西弗吉尼亚州惠灵会出现一个武汉，蒙大拿州海伦娜会出现一个武汉，诸如此类，

sentences.en: because hospitals will get overwhelmed everywhere.
sentences.zh: 因为到处都会出现医院不堪重负的情况。

sentences.en: And in Wuhan in the early weeks of the epidemic, the death rate was four to six percent.
sentences.zh: 在疫情爆发的头几周的武汉，死亡率是百分之四到百分之六。

sentences.en: It's a little unclear because there were people who couldn't make it to the hospitals and just died at home.
sentences.zh: 这有点说不准，因为有些人无法去医院，只能死在家中。

sentences.en: But if you go on the South China Morning Post site and you look for the videos that were shot then, you'll see hospitals with people crowded in the corridors
sentences.zh: 但如果你去看《南华早报》的网站，寻找当时拍摄的视频，你会看到医院走廊里挤满了人，

sentences.en: and literally dead bodies lying in the halls that nobody's had time to take away.
sentences.zh: 大厅里甚至躺着来不及被运走的冰冷尸体。

sentences.en: You'll see nurses and doctors screaming, having breakdowns, screaming in frustration, I can't take it anymore, I can't take it anymore.
sentences.zh: 你会看到护士和医生在尖叫、情绪崩溃、绝望地尖叫着“我受够了，我再也受不了了”。

sentences.en: You will see lines of coffins outside the crematories just sitting there waiting for their turn to go into the furnace because there's too many coffins for the flames
sentences.zh: 你会看到火葬场外面排着一排排的棺材，它们就那样停在那里，等待轮到自己进入火化炉，因为棺材太多，火焰

sentences.en: to burn fast enough.
sentences.zh: 根本无法足够快地将其烧尽。

sentences.en: I mean, we have seen that in Wuhan and we've seen it in Italy where they were having to stack coffins on the pews of the churches that had been closed down
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们在武汉看到过这种情况，在意大利也看到过，由于没有地方安置棺材，他们不得不把棺材叠放在已经关闭的教堂长椅上，

sentences.en: because there was no place to put the coffins and they couldn't dig graves fast enough.
sentences.zh: 因为根本没有地方放棺材，他们也无法足够快地挖好坟墓。

sentences.en: So that's what we're headed for.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们正要迎来的结局。

sentences.en: I mean, it's horrific.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这太可怕了。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: And we've,
sentences.zh: 我们，

sentences.en: I've been looking at this stuff since late January, early February and frightened by it.
sentences.zh: 我从一月下旬、二月上旬开始就一直在关注这些东西，并感到害怕。

sentences.en: The visions are nightmarish and I don't see anybody taking it seriously.
sentences.zh: 这些景象宛如噩梦，但我没看到任何人对此认真对待。

sentences.en: But that's what we're headed for.
sentences.zh: 但这就是我们正在走向的结局。

sentences.en: It's kind of hard
sentences.zh: 这有点难以

sentences.en: to process this because
sentences.zh: 消化，因为

sentences.en: what you're suggesting is that a short-term essentially shutdown of much of our life in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你所建议的是，在美国基本上对我们的大部分生活进行一次短期的关闭

sentences.en: would potentially bring this whole pandemic to an end.
sentences.zh: 可能会彻底终结这场大流行病。

sentences.en: And yet there are a lot of practical reasons why that would be very, very hard to imagine.
